name: Bidding

subjectOf.text: The CRDAO drives code review prices down through a bidding process and provides open access to anyone who qualifies rather than only members of the code review cartel.
subjectOf.abstract: The CRDAO provides a decentralized community-driven code review process that utilizes a bidding process on code reviews to drive prices down. It provides open access for code reviews from anyone who qualifies – not just members of the code review cartel.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: a functioning code review DAO with decentralized governance

subjectOf.text: The CRDAO price discovery mechanism enables full price transparency for consumers through the visibility of internal and external bids on job posts, which is unprecedented in a market otherwise dominated by a cartel.
subjectOf.abstract: price discovery mechanism serves a key public service function in that it enables full price transparency for consumers based on the visibility of the internal and external bids on job posts. This price transparency is unique and unprecedented in a market that is otherwise dominated by a cartel.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
scope_conditions: bids on the post and the winner become public after the customer selects

subjectOf.text: The Code Review DAO drives review prices down by running a decentralized, community driven review process built on a bidding process, combined with open access for any qualified reviewer rather than membership in a few firms.
subjectOf.abstract: which facilitates a decentralized community-driven code review process that utilizes a bidding process on code reviews to drive prices down
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750
